g.text: SCALE 6:1 IN HEIGHT · SM / SOLID / ROUNDED · WIDTH SCHEMATIC
WITHOUT CLOSE: OMIT Z1 AND ONE S2. WITHOUT GLYPH: OMIT I1 AND ONE S2.

svg.text: HOVER WASH IS ABSOLUTE AND INHERITS R1.
CONTENT IS Z-10. NO DROP SHADOW OR SCRIM.
LABEL SHRINKS AND TRUNCATES AT THE LIMIT.
CLOSE IS OPTIONAL; HIT EXTENDS S3.
BASE UI OWNS DISMISSAL AND PRESENCE.
PLAIN HAS NO FIXED HEIGHT OR PADDING.
BOXED VARIANTS SHARE THE SIZE MAP.
WRAP USES AUTO HEIGHT AND TOP ALIGNMENT.
GLYPH / DOT CENTRES ON THE FIRST LINE.
STATUS CHANGES INK AND OPTIONAL FILL.
ALL SIX STATUSES SHARE THE SAME GEOMETRY.
CLOSE COLLAPSES WIDTH; REDUCED MOTION SKIPS.
BOXED SIZE MAP · SM / MD / LG
DOT REPLACES GLYPH; NOT AN EXTRA SLOT.
SCALE 4:1 IN HEIGHT · N = 2 · SM / B = 0
WRAP BYPASSES LABEL MORPH; ICON STILL MORPHS.
OUTLINE ADDS 2·B TO AUTO HEIGHT. WIDTH REMAINS PARENT-CAPPED.
SCALE 2:1 IN HEIGHT · ALL WIDTHS SCHEMATIC
